steps.text:
All 3 tests pass now. 

I fixed `parse_duration` in `duration.py` to handle combined duration strings like `'1h30m'`. The original implementation only matched single-unit strings (e.g., `'2h'` or `'45s'`). I replaced it with a single regex that matches any combination of hours, minutes, and seconds (e.g., `'1h30m'`, `'2h'`, `'45s'`, `'1h30m45s'`), and sums up the total seconds.
